knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)

## Goal

Creates an Rmd document that is renderd into a PDF with the selected outputs in the application.

- On: `run_app(..., enable_odg = TRUE)`.
- Dataset list needs a `load_fn` attribute: a function with no arguments and independent from its parent environment.
- A module can return an entry `to_odg` from its server.

## Document contents

### For users

The download is a zip with the document as a PDF and the files that produced it. The document contains:

- The selected outputs, one section per module, recomputed from the data with the filters and settings in place in the app.
- Where the data comes from: modification dates, a hash per dataset to check it is the data loaded in the app, and the filters applied.
- The session info and any warnings raised while rendering.

### For developers

The document is an R Markdown file that rebuilds everything from code: first the data (`load_fn`, subgroups and filter), then one chunk per `to_odg` element. It is rendered in a separate R process, so each element's code must run without the app session. An element that cannot be produced shows an error in its place instead of failing the document.

## What the module server returns

```
server(afmm) returns
└─ list(
     to_odg = list(                       # named, names unique within the module
       <element_name> = list(             # elements appear in this order
         label   = "...",                 # optional: section title, defaults to <element_name>
         info    = "...",                 # optional: defaults to label
         codegen = list(                  # one entry per output format
           pdf  = <metareactive | chunk>,
           html = <metareactive | chunk>
         )
       ),
       ...
     )
   )
```

## `codegen` option 1: metareactive

```{r}
listing <- shinymeta::metaReactive(
  {
    adsl <- ..(afmm[["filtered_dataset_list"]]())[["adsl"]]
    adsl[adsl[["AGE"]] > ..(input[["min_age"]]), ]
  },
  varname = "listing"
)

list(
  to_odg = list(
    listing = list(
      label = "Listing",
      codegen = list(pdf = listing, html = listing)
    )
  )
)
```

## `codegen` option 2: chunk

```{r}
chunk <- structure(
  function(header) {
    paste0(header, "```{r}\nplot(1:10)\n```")
  },
  class = "chunk"
)
```

- A `function(header)` with class `"chunk"` that returns Rmd markup as a single string. The markup is inserted as is.
- `header` is the section title, already formatted for the output format and ending in a blank line.

## Code formatting with air

The R code in the document is formatted with [air], using the following logic.

1. `options(dv_odg_air_path = "/path/to/air")`
2. environment variable `DV_ODG_AIR_PATH`
3. `air` on the `PATH`
4. Otherwise, unformatted.
